DIN hosts four other-engineering/Health doctorates; its Mechanics PhD formal curricula are Industrial Design/Manufacturing, Fluid Machinery/Energy/Mechanical Plants, and Thermal Physics/HVAC/Plasma, not Industrial Engineering. Mathematics formal areas, Data Science structure, Statistics and Computer Science research areas do not name an additional Ops/MS/IE doctorate. Unrelated aerospace/automotive/health programme topics are outside bounded title scope.
